thread:
morgan: Quick check  deep-links to items we moved in the IA cleanup. Should old links keep working or do we redirect?

tara: Keep public links stable. Resolve via router aliasing and surface a small "moved" indicator. One-time toast on first visit.

devin: Router plan: try exact -> alias map -> canonical. We'll normalize breadcrumbs to the canonical path so UI matches current IA.

alex: UX: auto-expand target group, smooth scroll + focus the item, update breadcrumb to new location, and show muted pill: "moved from Workspaces" with a tooltip to migration notes.

sam: A11y: when auto-expanding, focus the item and use aria-live to announce new location. The "moved" pill must be keyboard focusable if interactive and meet color contrast.

morgan: Implementation notes: expand -> requestAnimationFrame -> scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) -> focus({preventScroll:true}). Also use history.replaceState if we want browser URL to show canonical without breaking share links.

devin: Will add a single JSON alias spec in infra: pattern -> canonical with param substitution. Version it per release.

alex: Metrics: % deep-link resolved by alias, tooltip/learn-more clicks, 404s for 2 weeks post-rollout.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled: 2024-12-08 02:00 UTC :rocket:

morgan: I'll open the spec PR with designs, toast copy, and a11y checklist. Assigning tasks now.
